paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minADE20 for different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.1 to 1.0, has six tick labels at intervals of 0.2, and is unitless. The y-axis is labeled "minADE20", has a linear scale, ranges from 15.5 to 17.5, and has seven tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The plot displays five lines representing different methods: TrajCL (blue, solid line with circle markers), Head Tuning (orange, solid line with circle markers), FT (green, solid line with circle markers), LoRA 16 (red, solid line with circle markers), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line with circle markers). The TrajCL line starts at approximately 16.7 at a ratio of 0.1, decreases to around 15.55 at a ratio of 1.0, with a notable drop between ratios 0.1 and 0.3. The Head Tuning line remains relatively steady, starting at around 17.55 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to approximately 17.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The FT line begins at about 17.0 at a ratio of 0.1, decreases to around 15.8 at a ratio of 0.8, and then slightly increases to approximately 16.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 line starts at around 17.4 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to approximately 16.9 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 line begins at about 17.45 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to around 16.9 at a ratio of 1.0.
